statements.statement: The FY24 capital plan lists construction for the turf field walls and drainage at a placeholder figure the superintendent called a guesstimate, with a feasibility study and plans before it.

warnings.about: Turkey Hill and turf field facilities
warnings.prediction: Turkey Hill's systems will need major spending and a decision on renovate or replace will be needed; the retaining wall and fence will not improve and will likely deteriorate.
